summary: Iteration 122: Testing Cyclic Multi-Model Repair Flow in EquipmentQuoteWizard. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified the complete cyclic flow: model selection, quantity input, serial entry, model confirmation, multiple models support, and PDF generation with Serial Annexe.

minor.issue: repair_models field is saved to DB but not exposed in Quote model response. Data is persisted correctly but not returned in API. This is a minor issue as the PDF generation works correctly.

issues: React hydration warnings about <tr> inside <span> and <span> inside <tbody> - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality (same as previous iterations)

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add repair_models field to Quote model in models.py to expose it in API responses
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created and cleaned up test quotes during PDF generation tests. 21 POS/Pinpad hardware items available for model selection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 122 complete. Cyclic Multi-Model Repair Flow verified: 1) POST /api/quotes/validate-repair-serials works (Excel upload, header skipping, deduplication, validation). 2) POST /api/quotes/generate-equipment-pdf accepts repair_models array with model_name, quantity, serials. 3) PDF includes Serial Annexe page when repair_models have serials. 4) Serial Annexe includes disclaimer note. 5) Frontend EquipmentQuoteWizard shows cyclic flow: select model > enter quantity > enter serials > confirm > repeat or proceed. 6) Model search dropdown shows only POS/Pinpad items. 7) Quantity input required before serial entry. 8) Manual serial input works (type + Enter or click +). 9) Cannot add more serials than declared quantity. 10) Confirm model button appears only when serials count matches quantity. 11) Confirmed models appear in 'Modelos registrados' list. 12) Multiple models can be added. 13) Confirmation dialog shows repair models summary. 14) repair_models sent in PDF generation request.
